//: Base-image Lucee configuration fragment, merged into
/opt/lucee/server/lucee-server/context/.CFConfig.json by mura-merge-cfconfig
at build time from /opt/mura/cfconfig.base.d/. Downstream fragments go in
/opt/mura/cfconfig.d/ and are merged by docker/entrypoint.sh on every boot.
inspectTemplate decides whether Lucee ever re-reads a .cfm/.cfc it has
already compiled. The stock lucee/lucee 6.2.8 image ships no value and its
built-in default ('auto') never picked up an edited bind-mounted template -
only a Lucee restart did. Lucee 6.2.8 resolves ${ENV_VAR:default}
placeholders in this file (verified), so the value is taken from the
LUCEE_INSPECT_TEMPLATE environment variable at start-up:
once   - check a template's timestamp once per request (default; dev)
always - check on every include (slowest)
never  - never re-read; deploy by rebuilding (production)
auto   - Lucee's own heuristic (what the stock image did)
loggers.application: the stock image defines Lucee's 'application' logger
at level 'error', so a plain writeLog(text=...) / writeLog(application=true)
(type 'information') was discarded before it ever reached application.log -
which is why nothing from Mura or a plugin showed up in `docker logs` even
once the file was symlinked to stdout. 'info' lets those lines through;
the appender and path are Lucee's own defaults, restated because the merge
replaces the whole 'application' entry.
A downstream image can override any of this with its own fragment in
/opt/mura/cfconfig.d/ (later file names win). The '//' key is ignored.
